## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: PPV Base (Potential Buyer Audience)

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW ppv_base as
select
    a.user_id,
    shop_l2,
    item_l2,
    count(*) as ppv
from
traffic.dwd_view_di__reg_live a
inner join
shop_info b
on a.shop_id = b.shop_id
inner join
item_info c
on a.item_id = c.item_id
where
a.tz_type = 'local'
and a.grass_region = upper('${region}')
and a.grass_date between date'${yesterday}' - interval '14' day and date'${yesterday}'
and a.user_id is not null
group by 1,2,3
;
```

**来源**: `workflows/data_warehouse_us/dws/target_audience/`, `workflows/data_warehouse/target_audience_us/`, `workflows/data_warehouse/target_aduience/` (24 files, regions: SG/ID/MY/PH/TH/TW/VN/BR/MX/CO/CL)

### Snippet 2: App View Activity (Advertiser Tier Tag)

```sql
cache table view_nd
select
    shop_id
    ,'app' as platform
    ,sum(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN (date('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 29 DAYS)
              AND date('${grass_date}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_30d
    ,sum(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN (date('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 59 DAYS)
              AND (date('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 30 DAYS) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_30_60d
    ,sum(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN (date('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 364 DAYS)
              AND (date('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 60 DAYS) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_60_365d
from traffic.dwd_view_di__reg_live
where
grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
and grass_date >= date_sub(DATE('${grass_date}'),364)
and grass_region = upper('${region}')
and page_type = 'my_ads_homepage'
and domain_type = 'other'
group by 1,2
;
```

**来源**: `workflows/data_warehouse/dim/dim_advertiser_tier_tag__reg_s0_live/` (11 files, regions: SG/ID/MY/PH/TH/TW/VN/BR/MX/CO/CL)

### Snippet 3: shop_info (辅助表, Pre-built Cache)

```sql
cache table shop_info as
    SELECT
    a.shop_id,
    shop_level2_global_be_category_id as shop_l2
    FROM mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__reg_s0_live a
    inner join effective_shop b on a.shop_id = b.shop_id
    WHERE a.grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
    and a.grass_region = upper('${region}')
    and a.tz_type = 'local'
    and shop_level2_global_be_category_id is not null
;
```

### Snippet 4: item_info (辅助表, Pre-built Cache)

```sql
cache table item_info as
    select
    a.item_id,
    a.level2_global_be_category_id as item_l2
    from
    mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live a
    inner join effective_shop b on a.shop_id = b.shop_id
    WHERE a.grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
    and a.grass_region = upper('${region}')
    and a.tz_type = 'local'
    and a.level2_global_be_category_id is not null
;
```

### Snippet 5: PC View Activity (对比: 使用不同表)

```sql
-- PC side uses a different table for the same view_nd logic:
select
    shop_id
    ,'pc' as platform
    ,sum(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_30d
    ,...
from traffic.sellercenter_traffic_dwd_event_stream_di__reg_s1_live
where grass_region = upper('${region}')
and ...
and operation = 'view'
and page_type in ('seller_center_shopee_ads')
group by 1,2
;
```

**说明**: PC 端 view 数据在 `sellercenter_traffic_dwd_event_stream_di` 表，与 App 端 (`dwd_view_di`) 分开存储，通过 `UNION ALL` 合并。
